name: social-sign-in-buttons
title: Social sign-in buttons
description: Continue-with buttons for sign-in providers: monogram marks instead of brand logos, a last-used tag first in the list, and one busy state.
docs: Pass providers (id, label and an optional mark) and onSelect(id). While onSelect runs, that provider's button shows a spinner and the others disable; a rejection puts a message under the list. For a redirect flow pass busy yourself. lastUsed moves a provider first and tags it. The default marks are neutral monogram tiles built from the name (GH for GitHub, G for Google, one letter more when two would match), so no trademarked logo ships; bring your own with mark. In a narrow row the name moves up against its mark so it still fits. layout is stacked, grid or icons (square buttons with a tooltip); the list is labelled for screen readers.
